title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Georgia
part_text: 12. Recognises the right of the Georgian Parliament to ensure the transparency of foreign funding in the interest of national security and to prevent foreign malign influence; recognises the legislative efforts to modernise the financial oversight of non-profit sectors through the Law on Grants, aimed at ensuring maximum transparency, preventing illicit financial flows and aligning Georgia’s regulatory framework with international best practice for national security and financial integrity;
